paragraphs: He is mentioned in Shir HaShirim Rabbah, chapter 2, on verse 14, section 7.[^1]

notes.text: The stored Midrash Rabbah — TE, Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:14, section 7, explicitly names Rabbi Eliyahu. It supports the heading expansion and the chapter/verse/section reading, without identifying a historical Eliyahu or verifying print.
